response.sql: WITH department_counts AS (SELECT major.department AS department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id GROUP BY major.department), shares AS (SELECT department, member_count, member_count * 1.0 / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM department_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM shares) SELECT shares.department, shares.member_count, shares.share, shares.share - average_share.share AS share_minus_average FROM shares CROSS JOIN average_share WHERE shares.share >= average_share.share
